answer: A farm claiming large rewards across many aliases therefore has to lock proportionally more capital on each, which removes the advantage of spreading claims thin. Because the vertex collateral is checked against the atlas claim at intake, the jetty audit records the ratio and an under-collateralised submission is refused. Posted collateral must equal 5 times the reward claimed, so ambition is priced rather than free. That is 32 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
